data.title: Middleware Support Engineer
data.description:
TCS has been a great pioneer in feeding the fire of young techies like you. We are a global leader in the technology arena and there's nothing that can stop us from growing together.

What we are looking for

Role: Middleware Support Engineer L1.5

Location: Bengaluru

Exp: 3-8 yrs

Must have:

  1. Strong experience in Apache Tomcat, Apache HTTP Server, and Java-based applications.
  2. Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM – Author, Publisher, Dispatcher, Cache).
  3. Experience working with AWS services: EC2, EBS, ECS, EKS, RDS, S3, Load Balancer, Elastic Cache, IAM, Route 53, Lambda, Auto Scaling.
  4. Hands-on experience with Datadog (Synthetic & RUM Monitoring).
  5. Experience in ServiceNow (CRQ, Incident, MIM, CTASK, SCTASK) and Jira for ticket management

Good to have:

  1. Working knowledge of Splunk ITSI and AWS CloudWatch.
  2. Experience with Ansible Tower and Python automation.
